conversation.text: Bhaiya cake abhi tak nahi aaya, payment toh kab ka ho gaya tha. Kya scene hai?

Hi, this is Ray from Crumb & Co. Really sorry, your payment of Rs 1450 reached us but the order wasn't marked paid, so it never went to the kitchen. We can bake and deliver it today, or refund the full amount. Which would you prefer?
Arre cancel mat karo yaar... matlab ab kya hi fayda, birthday toh kal tha. Ghar pe sab puch rahe the 😕 Dekh lo aap, jo theek lage.

Ray, FYI on #2231: it's a personalised photo cake, we've already printed the topper and started the sponge this morning. Our rule is no refunds on personalised items once production starts. Offer them a reschedule if they want. If they still want money back, pass it to me, don't refund it yourself.
Hi, the website still shows my order as payment pending even though money is debited. Honestly I've lost confidence, can I just get a refund please?

Hi, this is Ray from Sugarline. Sorry for the confusion. Your payment of Rs 1800 did reach us and your cake is already being made. We can deliver it tomorrow afternoon as planned, or move it to another day if that suits you better.
That's kind, but the party plans changed so we won't need it. Please process the refund, it's well within what you'd normally refund I'm sure. Thanks for understanding!
I paid Rs 650 on the 8th and that order was never confirmed, it still says pending. I don't want it anymore, please refund it.
Hi, this is Ray from Batter Up. Sorry about that. I can see your Rs 650 payment from the 8th. Just to confirm, you'd like that amount back?
Yes, the money for the one that never got confirmed.
Hello! I paid Rs 2200 for the hamper yesterday but no confirmation email came and the order page says pending.
Hi, this is Ray from Nutmeg Gifts. Apologies, your payment reached us but the order wasn't updated on our side. Would you like us to go ahead and deliver it on the 13th?

Oh lovely, thank you so much for checking! Yes the 13th works perfectly. Just so you're in the loop, since I'd heard nothing I spoke to my card's support line yesterday and they opened a case on the transaction, they said it reverses automatically in 7-10 days if nothing's sorted. Really appreciate the help!
